manual_review.method: Implementing assistant reviewed original source, actual raw model output, original links/emphasis and rendered text. Not independent/blind and not a universal accuracy score.
manual_review.candidate_decision: Do not enable inline protected literals in production; no post-output prompt tuning or weight change.

manual_review.cache_semantics: Cache stores only outputs already accepted by existing structural/integrity checks. It preserves exactly the original generated bytes and does not correct semantic errors. Rejection, exceptions, cancellation, namespace/context/terminology changes, reset epoch and retained-size limits are checked separately.

visual_review.observations: Original sidebars, selected API/code/link style and code blocks retain their positions. Truncated Node paragraph remains English in place; no partial translation mounted. Candidate bitmap screenshot confirms semantic role errors despite preserved nodes. This only covers selected paragraphs, not whole-page visual correctness.

manual_review.conclusion: Opaque source values matter for some outputs but are not the only cause. Fixed text-node order and the model's format adaptation still affect participant/condition/predicate assignment. Keep cache optimization; freeze independent cases for evaluation; no basis here to discard the base model or automatically launch another fine-tune.

preserved_preparation_failures: Initial literal test forgot original leading whitespace; expectation corrected to existing source-whitespace contract.

limits: Source-only selection was preregistered, but semantic review is not independent/blind.

Known Promise/rollout vocabulary, participant, conditional and missing-predicate problems remain.
Cache preserves existing accepted output, including any semantic mistakes.
Shared CPU/concurrent validation differ between timings; warm queue milliseconds exclude extension messaging, DOM rendering and wllama startup.
Model/server process VmHWM is not total Firefox/machine peak.
Official API and full Firefox+wllama inference not rerun.
